newsitem.title: USA: Cadiz Land stake cut by FMR-led group.
newsitem.headline: Cadiz Land stake cut by FMR-led group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said it reduced its stake in Cadiz Land Co Inc to 8.74 percent, or 1,940,667 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 40,800 Cadiz shares between November 12 and December 3 at prices ranging from $4.19 to $4.75 a share.
The group previously held a 10.17 percent stake, or 1,991,467 shares, in Cadiz Land, an agricultural land development company based in Rancho Cucamonga, Calif.
FMR manages Fidelty Funds through its investment advisory unit.
